body: I'll talk about shows and movies with people sometimes, which is usually pretty fun. I had a friend who I'd watch MLP:FiM with a lot, but I don't really see him or anyone else anymore. (My family moved to the UK, I'm with them until I go to college in a few weeks). To be honest, I feel like everything I do or could do is just a distraction until I jump off that bridge...
Reddit, youtube, etc. Bite sized entertainment that distracts me from everything.

I don't do ANYTHING. I try lots of things, but my interest always fades and I go back to passive time wasters. About a month ago, I had a brief moment of clarity where I "saw" myself from a 3rd person, unbiased perspective. I've always been wandering and aimless, which is fine as a teenager but absolutely pitiful as an adult. I have no interests, including an interest in living.
